title: Gas Turbine Engineer (Automation)
jobDescription: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Senior Engineering Manager In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, develop and validate integrated control solutions for utility-scale gas turbine power plants, with a primary focus on replacing GE Mark V controls with ABB systems for Frame 5, 6B, and 9E turbines. The role is responsible for ensuring the seamless integration of automation, electrical, and digital systems, while maintaining compliance with relevant grid codes, safety standards, and operational performance requirements. The work model for the role is # LI - Onsite. This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India. Your role and responsibilities Control Architecture Design: Develop scalable, high-performance control architectures for gas turbine and combined-cycle plants. Validate system performance across various operating conditions, including start-up, load changes, and grid disturbances. Migration & Upgrade Projects: Lead engineering activities for Mark V to ABB control system migrations, including detailed I/O mapping, logic conversion, and validation of functional equivalence. Integration & Commissioning: Oversee integration with electrical systems, instrumentation, and plant DCS. Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and commissioning at international sites. Compliance & Standards: Ensure all work adheres to IEC, IEEE, NFPA, and local grid codes. Implement cybersecurity measures for control systems. Digital Enablement: Integrate predictive analytics, remote monitoring, and AI-driven diagnostics into control solutions. Documentation & Training: Prepare comprehensive engineering documentation, test procedures, and training materials for plant operators. Qualifications for the role At least 8-12 years’ experience in power plant automation, specifically in gas turbine control (experience with GE Mark V and ABB Symphony Plus is highly desirable). Proven track record of successful retrofit or upgrade projects for turbine control systems and Strong proficiency in control logic design, PLC/DCS programming, and HMI development. Hands-on experience with ABB Symphony Plus and GE Mark V control systems, as well as relevant communication protocols (such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850) and excellent project management and effective stakeholder communication skills. Ability to influence and drive change across global initiatives and analytical approach and strong problem-solving abilities for complex integration projects. Certifications (Preferred)- ABB Control Systems Certification, Cybersecurity for Industrial Control Systems and PMP or equivalent project management certification. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, or Automation Engineering. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement. Conduct performance tuning at query, transformation, and model levels—using aggregations, partitioning strategies, and data volume optimization techniques. Validate authorization concepts using BW Analysis Authorizations and SAC role models. You will be mainly accountable for: Generating service inquiries, engaging with potential customers, and maintaining strong relationships in Aluminium, Zinc, and Copper smelters, Chemical plants (Caustic chlorine/Chlorine dioxide), Graphite, and Electroplating industries. Selecting and configuring rectifiers and transformers, preparing specifications for rectifier transformers, harmonic filters, and cooling systems. Conducting techno-commercial evaluations of vendor offers at the pre-bid stage and preparing competitive techno-commercial proposals. Leading techno-commercial discussions with customers, ensuring clear communication and alignment with their requirements. Strong expertise in business development, client relationship management, and tender/contract handling.
